supplement.heading: S39. Terminal permutation: a precise invariance theorem
paragraphs: Let I be immutable item IDs, Omega a common nonempty world set, and R_i(omega,b) a static observation relation. A subset M is fixed before any observations. Its order pi is a permutation of M; b is a positional label tuple, while z={pi_j maps to b_j} is the terminal ID function. Define F_pi(b) by the conjunction of all R_pi_j(omega,b_j). Closed threshold bins may overlap: either retain the same relation on both sides or use one identical deterministic boundary rule. Changing the rule with order violates the theorem. [C23]

Theorem (terminal reindexing). For another permutation sigma of the same M define T(b)_j=b_(pi inverse(sigma_j)). T has inverse T from sigma back to pi, and F_pi(b)=F_sigma(T(b)). Hence feasible tuple sets correspond bijectively, infeasible tuples remain infeasible, and the infimum, supremum and width of the same Delta agree. Proof: every item-ID observation atom occurs once on both sides with the same label; conjunction order changes no atom. Substituting them gives both set inclusions. Inversion follows by composing the two positional index maps. [C23]

If all selected items are immediately and always available, are revealed once, and the policy reads all M before a history-independent terminal STOP, additive C(M) and affordability under Q agree. An order-invariant terminal predictor P(M,z) has equal terminal loss. Maximizing width over the terminal bijection preserves R(M) and transports every maximizing label; applying this argument to a common subset family preserves the (risk,price,mask) choice and all affordable primary-risk subset ties. This is a mathematical consequence for the family, not a newly executed all-subset study. [C23,C24]

The empty subset has the unique empty order and tuple, F(())=Omega, price 0 and full worst tie set {()}. An empty base Omega is an invalid model, never a zero-risk observation. If infima/suprema are not attained their equality still follows from equal world sets; the stored finite-binary compact polytopes attain both. A common prior pushed forward along T preserves expected terminal loss across orders, which still does not equate expectation with a worst value. [C23]

In the saved static witness M={0,2}, actual W41 enumeration order [2,0] becomes canonical [0,2]. Positional (0,1) maps to (1,0), both meaning z(0)=1,z(2)=0. Its sharp interval is [-11/90,43/90], with width 54/90=3/5; both price 2. Both z(2)=0 readings are worst ties. The other two ID readings have width 17/30, so the widths are not constant and W42's full-support constant-width bridge is not established. [C25]

supplement.heading: S40. Action order, solver diagnostics and a deadline counterexample
paragraphs: Three objects must remain distinct: a terminal ID reading (M,z), an acquisition action sequence A, and the solver diagnostic prefix record D. W41's stop-error-first order at research.py lines 216-225 controls static enumeration/label coordinates; it is not a record that sensors ran in that time order. D can contain visits, bounds, incumbent updates, cache hits and strict-prune decisions. Terminal equivalence asserts none of those prefix facts. [C24]

With common reveal/boundary/STOP semantics, equal order functions on reachable inputs imply equal acquisition traces by induction on their positions. Conversely, if all items are acquired and traces preserve IDs, literal trace equality forces the same item at each position. Distinct permutations therefore differ at the first unequal ID, even if the observed labels coincide. Different prefixes can condition on different subsets and yield different bounds, pruning and total work. The theorem does not predict a solver speedup. [C24]

The counterexample changes the environment identically for both schedules: items {0,2}, unit duration and price, hard budget 2, completion deadlines d0=1 and d2=2, four bit worlds and target XOR. Order [0,2] completes at times 1 and 2. Order [2,0] reveals item 2 at time 1, then rejects item 0 before acquisition because its proposed completion 2 exceeds deadline 1. All four [2,0] schedules are infeasible; all four [0,2] schedules complete. The rejected prefix pays price 1 and leaves XOR width 1; completion pays 2 and leaves width 0. Lower incomplete-prefix price is not a successful cheap policy. [C26]

Two IDs are minimal for distinct permutations; one world suffices to show schedule infeasibility. The four constructed worlds additionally show residual target uncertainty and do not claim minimal world count or empirical failure probability. The comparison demonstrates violation of static always-available reveals under a common changed deadline model. It is not an improvement over the original W41 problem and must not be pooled with static width rows as an algorithm benchmark. [C26]

figure.caption: Completion counts 0/4 versus 4/4 for the same four constructed worlds, under the same new deadlines. This is a deterministic assumption-violation counterexample, not a sampled success rate, sensor trial or algorithm-superiority estimate. [C26,F4]

supplement.heading: S41. Complexity and measurement limits
paragraphs: Let N=sum n_j, A=sum a_j, b=min(B,A), and P be the number of participants. A conservative sharp endpoint cost is H=O(sum_j 2^a_j*n_j*log(n_j)+P*(b+1)^2) rational operations, with implementation-specific caches. All subsets and their binary readings contain sum_S 2^|S|=3^N complete labels; full prefix traversal has at most 2*3^N-2^N nodes. The full solver therefore remains exponential even when its envelope allocation becomes cheaper. Required complete tie coordinates, copied box keys, DFS frames and serialized raw records have output-sensitive storage costs. [C08,C16,C20]

The shared-cap allocation module uses O(sum_j B*min(B,a_j)) rational DP transitions, O(B) rolling layers and stored local tables. The implicit heap uses O(N+P+q*log(max(2,P))) rational work including aggregation, q<=min(B,sum a_j), and O(P) heap storage. These bounds concern the envelope allocator; the separate sharp endpoint can still enumerate binary placements and use DP. Fraction GCD, products, comparisons and integer bit growth add costs not captured by rational-operation counts.

Single-run instrumented CPU is neither randomized timing evidence nor a throughput guarantee. In W41 B=2 the heap used less observed CPU than DP but more than sharp-prefix, and had larger peak Python allocations and output than DP. No additional pruning or endpoint reduction occurred. Tracemalloc peak is not RSS; logical file lengths are not physical I/O; returned or sampled Fraction bits do not bound every temporary product. Zero-rounded short-phase CPU means below timer resolution, while missing measurements remain null/unknown. [C20]

W42 review found two remaining complexity gaps: the written O(K*m^2*h^2) policy-audit bound omits the nonzero stop-only h=0 branch, and the claimed Omega(K*T) storage does not distinguish shared child objects from complete serialized tree lengths. This synthesis withdraws those expressions as general validated bounds; it does not claim to repair them with a new theorem. A revised account must separate explicit serialized length sum from shared in-memory objects, original-world scans and arithmetic bits. [C22]

For already supplied valid permutations and fixed-length label references, the new reindexing operation uses O(1+k) average dictionary operations and O(k) additional references, k=|M|. ID hashing/comparison and copying or serializing variable-length labels have their own bit/byte cost; writing L bytes costs at least Omega(L). Enumerating 2^k binary tuples, computing endpoints E(Omega,M,z), rational arithmetic and diagnostic output remain separate. The empty tuple still incurs validation/call work. This local bound does not repair the W42 h=0 policy-generation or shared-object/full-serialization issue. [C28]

supplement.heading: S42. sequential-objective analysis: sequential prediction and fixed-subset width are different tasks
paragraphs: The saved GSMRL body describes acquisition and terminal prediction loss. W42 inspected 98,206 selected source bytes and 132 math nodes, with zero alttext/TeX mismatches. The reviewer also read an additional header interval, giving 100,488 bytes in the union. This establishes the recorded extraction and reading scope, not correctness of 132 mathematical statements or identity to a particular publisher/arXiv edition. Printed Equation 1 is per-instance; expected undiscounted loss is the author's explicit MDP interpretation with gamma=1 and no shaping. The original AO* paper and the 2002/2004 identity were not directly established. [C21,C22]

The saved conditional translation matches worlds, feasible observations, prices, hard budgets and precommitted subset policies. It additionally bridges terminal loss to conditional width g(S,omega)=W(S,x_S(omega)); this changes a prediction target when encoded as regression to zero. Under a fixed full-support distribution, E[g]=max W for a given subset if and only if every feasible transcript has constant width: every term p_t(max W-W_t) is nonnegative and their sum vanishes only when each gap does. Alpha=0, a common hard budget, the same secondary lex rule and separately retained complete primary ties then support the restricted value/tie correspondence. Positive additive price can destroy unequal-price primary ties. Maximizing over all distributions restores a maximum but changes the problem. [C21]

The W42 review required a narrower execution claim: W41 orders known stop-error coordinates first and then indices; W42 uses increasing-index canonical subsets. The W44 theorem now supplies the explicit terminal permutation map under static assumptions. Literal original-program ordered traces, prefix bounds/prunes/cache/incumbents and schedule-dependent cases remain outside that result. Availability, delay, failure and chronology can invalidate the quotient, as the common-deadline counterexample shows. The original W42 ordered-program equivalence was not established, and the later terminal result does not retroactively close its review. [C22-C26]

Witness 1 has one feature and three worlds: expected priced loss buys A at 3/8, while worst priced loss stops at 1. Fixed-subset worst conditional Delta=y width is 1 for both empty and one-feature subsets. Witness 2 has two features and three worlds: observe A, stop when A=0, otherwise buy B. It has zero error and expected price 3/2, giving 3/32 at alpha=1/16; the best fixed subset buys both for 1/8. Both have worst price 2, zero final error and zero worst width. The eleven public policies, six subset tables and 51 original-world arithmetic checks are exhaustive finite witnesses, not trained GSMRL, a replay of W41, or new empirical samples. [C21]

The W42 expected-versus-worst and adaptive-versus-static witnesses retain their original objectives and arithmetic after W44. Reindexing observations neither supplies a learned prior nor imposes constant width, alpha=0 or gamma=1. The two sets of results can therefore be read together without inferring a general GSMRL-to-minimax reduction. In particular, the static W44 widths 3/5 and 17/30 differ across readings. [C21,C25]

supplement.heading: S43. Validation scope, finite denominators and unmeasured cost
paragraphs: The W44 author main stored eight static rows and eight deadline rows, and its separately written raw-only arithmetic audited the same sixteen. The reported total 32 counts passes over saved checks. A separate coordinator recomputed four distinct static conjunctions and the eight schedule/world rows without importing or replaying the study. These checks found zero endpoint mismatches and preserved all closed-boundary labels and worst ties. They provide finite implementation evidence; the general theorem rests on its proof and assumptions. [C25,C26,C29]

W44 direct-stage CPU/wall receipts cover one unit, main and raw-only audit process. Unit CPU/wall were 0.25/6.6203746 seconds; main 0.46875/3.9016218; audit 0.1875/0.3869421. These single stage observations have different work and are not a speed contest. Recorded scopes exclude startup before measurement, earlier ownership-gate CLI, shell, authoring, actual acquisition and model cost. Returned endpoint bits reached 7; intermediate rational growth, RSS and physical I/O remain unmeasured. [C28]

The saved independent review reports that the declared W44 path snapshots/gsmrl_response.bin does not exist. The full source actually preserved in the W22 origin has SHA256 68c70a3a4f6a0746648ab2d3c2eb56a0cceae2679f642e7020c38c06088335df; four W44 excerpts totaling 7,879 bytes match retained byte ranges. This edition links the real source and exact excerpts and leaves the incorrect historical path intact. It does not authenticate an external version. [C27,C29]

Some sentences in the frozen W44 METHOD review contain damaged question marks. We preserve those bytes as a historical defect and use readable raw results, code coordinates and the separate arithmetic review for this new document. We do not reconstruct missing review prose, assert that the previous intake hold was resolved, or count the current author's schema/hash/content checks as an independent scientific review. [C29]

supplement.heading: S44. What the cumulative evidence supports
paragraphs: Equal component weights, fixed quote coefficients and worst interval width are declared research objectives, rather than elicited stakeholder preferences. A policy can reduce component errors while worsening complete diagnoses, or reduce expected quoted price while leaving worst price unchanged. The cumulative record therefore keeps target-specific failures and denominators beside each favorable contrast. Clinical safety, participant benefit and industrial utility require evidence beyond the selected scalar objective and remain unmeasured here.

The evidence supports completed local observation contracts, exact conditional numerical contrasts, finite counterexamples, and saved theorem arguments for a declared robust world model. It supports several negative conclusions: no admitted MHEALTH routing gain, no new information at unmeasured fallback cells, no generic submodular guarantee, no objective gain over a matched exact solver, and no consistent total-cost advantage of pruning/DP/heap variants. It also preserves specific theoretical gains, including sharpness outside the failed slack shortcut and tighter shared-cap envelopes, with their domains stated. [C07-C22]

The six W42 review areas remain dated evidence: architecture and finite same-information baselines existed; algorithm correspondence, complexity, application evaluation and related-work version matching were partial. The new ID-preserving terminal quotient answers one narrowly stated semantic question. Literal original-program execution equivalence, stop-only/shared-object/output complexity, independent measured acquisition utility and original AO* primary/version comparison remain needs_evidence. A source hash, accepted Task, terminal theorem or new manuscript does not close those scientific questions. [C22-C29]

supplement.heading: S45. Saved feedback, limitations and the next decisive evidence
paragraphs: The saved current-review distribution concern remains active in this cumulative edition. A one-rig exposed Hydraulic result, a two-participant MHEALTH result and a constructed multi-participant fixture have different support. They cannot be pooled into an independent final study, and repeated wave publication does not create a new physical unit. The later theory explains what assumptions would identify an answer; it does not supply the missing independent population or physical-acquisition observations requested by that review.

The saved current-review baseline concern is answered by preserving its negative result rather than selecting a more attractive diagnostic. Hydraulic v15 still admits k=1 and its unchanged nine price-budget decisions; MHEALTH routing still ties the strongest selected myopic rule; shared-cap DP and heap still match the same exact risks and ties. Unselected predictor gains, altered objectives and lower counts for one internal operation remain separately labeled and cannot replace the admitted comparison.

Historical Big Guy highlights in the local library are publication-based editorial interpretations of public writings; the named scholars did not review this work. The newer v15 current-review links point to actual saved Codex review issues PF15-DISTRIBUTION and PF15-BASELINE, authored in a separate lane of the same native session, with their stated audit scope. This edition maps those saved concerns to new exact paragraphs and preserves the original attribution limits. Generic companion reading marks are not feedback, and no new professor, external or model review was commissioned.

A decisive application study would first define independent participant/device units, frozen predictor and information rights, true availability/failure/latency and cost receipts, and a loss chosen for the intended user. Strong static, same-STOP myopic and permitted adaptive controls would share data, tuning opportunities, budgets and outputs. Missing/failed/unknown/no-gain records would remain in denominators; physical and model costs would have explicit scopes. Until those contracts and observations exist, actual acquisition/model evaluation is not_started with cost null and science_status needs_evidence. The cumulative edition preserves completed work without claiming that the remaining research is complete.

The combined contribution is a traceable boundary between completed local evidence and remaining inference: an explicit shared-source/disclosure design, exposed and registered negative application results, sharp assumption-dependent identification, exact fixed-subset selection with complete ties, and a terminal invariance theorem whose deadline counterexample marks its domain. None of these converts an unchanged strongest baseline, unobserved fallback, higher retained cost or invalid schedule into an admitted practical gain.

supplement.heading: S46. A return to prediction: frozen representations and source identity
paragraphs: The historical MHEALTH15-mask RF bank and the W45-W47 single mask-aware RF are different predictor contracts over related source windows. The former fits subjects1-3, calibrates4 and reports527 target windows from9-10. The latter was fitted once on1098 windows from1-4, augmented across16 masks to17568 encoded rows, with69 normalized channel-summary features plus4 observation bits. Thirty-two conditional trees were fitted in W45 across two participant-separated conditional folds. W46 and W47 reuse the frozen predictor and fold0; the two conditional-fit participant IDs5 and6 do not denote two new fits. Current new_fits=0. [C30,C31]

Frozen NPZ copies for subjects5,6,7,8 contain264,250,266,258 windows respectively. The current524-window DEV pool is subjects7-8, rather than the historical527-window target pool. The split is by participant role, but repeated analysis and policy selection on these exposed people remove any fresh confirmatory interpretation. The subject5/6 arrays are read by this edition for descriptive and historical-fit-audit provenance; no learning is repeated. Original source identity, admitted feature identity and model identity have separate hashes.

The descriptive EDA verifies dimensions, finite feature values, class counts and unique128-row-aligned offsets. A finite admitted feature array does not establish absence of missing source readings or correctness of the original physical sensor axes. Feature standard deviations span heterogeneous native units; this is a reason to preserve the training-only normalization, not to refit it on DEV. The four engineering groups remain9,6,27,27 features. Raw activity labels are available to the post hoc evaluator, while the selector's public encoding receives only acquired values and observation bits.

supplement.heading: S47. The action-local rule and its conditional theorem
paragraphs: At the fixed public state the first group/action0 has been acquired, mask=1, spent=1, remaining=1, total=2 and cache is empty. Let F be feasible next actions1,2,3. Each action's frozen fitting leaf supplies a mean loss reduction mu_a and support metadata. S contains only actions with at least30 fitting windows and two fitting participants. With one-quote actions and lambda=0.05, choose the smallest-index supported action maximizing mu_a-0.05 only when the maximum is strictly positive; otherwise STOP. Empty support and nonpositive fitted gain have distinct reasons. [C32]

The blanket ablation applies this same choice only if S=F, otherwise it STOPs. Thus both rules coincide when every feasible action is supported. When some action is unsupported but a different supported action has positive fitted value, only local admission can buy. Every local purchase is supported by construction and at most one additional quote is used. Its fitted incremental value max(0,max over S of mu_a-0.05) weakly exceeds the blanket rule's value; there is no implication for realized prediction error, rare-event safety, population risk or true acquisition value. The local myopic control independently sorts the same values under the same support/STOP/tie rules and therefore defines the identical decision map.

Support-gated fixed subsets1,3,5,9 retain only their one predetermined optional action and buy it when supported, with no positive-net requirement and no replacement. Fixed orders[0,1],[0,2],[0,3] additionally require positive fitted value under multipliers0.5,1,2. All16 policies share the model, first acquired group, attempt cap, information and support lookup rights. This limited fixed-prefix catalogue is not the original full-budget policy class. Thirty-four incompatible static policies, representing17816 paths, were unexecuted and must not be scored as zeros.

algorithm.name: One-remaining-quote action-local admission
inputs: Frozen73-input RF and fold0 conditional trees; public acquired group0 values/mask1; spent1,remaining1,total2,empty cache.
Feasible actions1,2,3; per-action fitting leaf counts/participants; quote1,lambda0.05; lower-index tie rule.

Encode only acquired group0 and observation bits; compute the frozen initial prediction.
Look up each feasible action's conditional leaf using public state, retaining its fitting window/participant support and mean.
Build S using each action's own30-window/two-participant predicate; do not veto one supported action because a different action is unsupported.
If S is empty, STOP insufficient_support. Otherwise select maximum mean minus0.05 with smallest action-index tie; if value<=0 STOP nonpositive.
Before a positive purchase, validate remaining quote/control/time, write intent, copy only the selected local group, debit quote and compute final prediction.

supplement.heading: S52. Exact preference sensitivity of a frozen hydraulic gate
paragraphs: This restores the substantive preference derivation from the older detailed supplement, not merely its topic label. The comparison fixes secondary gate g301/k3 versus locked fixed mask3, equal source prices (1,1,1), cap2 and the same421 exposed evaluation cycles. No policy is refitted or selected for a new preference. Alpha weights complete diagnosis against mean-head loss; lambda weights the separately normalized source quote. They are independent decision parameters.

For cycle i and mask m, d_i(m) is an integer number of wrong heads in0..4 and v_i(m)=1 when at least one head is wrong. Component loss is d_i/4; vector loss is v_i. Their convex mixture expresses a preference: alpha0 values each head equally, alpha1 values complete-diagnosis success. It does not transform four dependent head decisions into four independent samples.

Each source quote is1 and a mask may cost at most2. Therefore the mean cost term divides total quotes by3n; the component term divides total wrong heads by4n and the vector term divides wrong cycles byn. In this continuation only, the cost normalizer3 is fixed by the equal-price contract. Replacing it by another price book without changing the derivation is invalid. Lambda cannot authorize an action outside the cap.

The fixed mask3 has924 wrong head decisions,381 wrong complete diagnoses and842 quotes. The unchanged g301 has861,391 and518 respectively. Their signed differences are-63,+10,-324. Component improvement and complete-diagnosis regression are simultaneously true; neither cancels the other before a preference is declared.

Multiplying the component change by1-alpha gives(-63+63alpha)/1684. The vector change is10alpha/421=40alpha/1684. The normalized cost change is-324lambda/1263=-432lambda/1684. Adding them yields(-63+103alpha-432lambda)/1684. The103 coefficient therefore combines63 lost units of component emphasis and40 units of complete-diagnosis penalty; it is not a fitted regression slope.

The zero set isalpha=(63+432lambda)/103. Withlambda0 it is63/103; withlambda1/20 it is423/515. Below the boundary the frozen gate has lower scalar loss, on it the losses tie, and above it fixed mask3 has lower loss. Atlambda5/54 the line reachesalpha1; beyond that cost weight g301 has strictly lower scalar loss for everyalpha in[0,1]. At the threshold onlyalpha1 ties.

Although the gate wins these weighted comparisons at sufficiently large lambda, it still does not dominate the three-coordinate outcome vector: its vector-error coordinate is worse. Cost preference has compensated that regression, not removed it. If one chooses the arbitrary numerical diagonalalpha=lambda, the same algebra gives(-63-329alpha)/1684<0; this one-dimensional slice is not a reason to identify the two parameters or to select them using evaluation outcomes.

The phase diagram evaluates the same two locked outputs everywhere. Its cells are dependent recalculations, not60 separately trained policies or60 independent trials. Policies chosen by a new alpha/lambda-specific fit/dev search would be a different experiment, requiring a new locked candidate-selection protocol and independent evaluation.

The six exact cells below describe the same two outputs. The full region is: for 0<=lambda<5/54, gate wins when alpha<alpha*(lambda), ties at the boundary, and loses above it; at lambda=5/54 gate wins for alpha<1 and ties at1; for lambda>5/54 it wins the scalar objective for every alpha in[0,1]. This does not become Pareto dominance because vector failures remain10 higher. Negative lambda and alpha outside[0,1] are outside this preference contract.

supplement.heading: S54. Prospective transfer roles, failed attempts and constrained policy selection
paragraphs: This is a prospective implementation contract, not executed PAMAP2 acquisition. After verifying the actual Protocol archive and rights, order eligible participant IDs by a fixed label-independent hash. For nine eligible participants assign the first three to predictor training, next two to policy fitting, next two to development selection and final two to reserved test. Thus the earlier five fit subjects are split into disjoint 3+2 roles. If inventory or activity support differs, stop and amend before test access; these planned counts are not a power calculation.

Fit normalizers and the mask-aware predictor or fixed per-mask predictor bank only on the three predictor-training subjects. Freeze them before fitting selectors. The two policy-fit subjects supply acquisition/risk training examples; development selects among predeclared candidates and test is opened once for final reporting. Do not silently refit the predictor on five subjects after policy selection. Any such refit is a separate named intervention with its own controls.

The primary task uses nonoverlapping 256-sample completed windows within one Protocol subject/session and one activity-label segment, after raw-time continuity checks. Exclude label0 transition segments from this conditional offline target and retain their counts. Label-based curation defines an evaluation subset; a deployed actor cannot use that gold label or future segment boundaries to choose acquisition. Online prefix inference needs a separate causal windowing contract.

Before fitting, verify internal column names for 16g acceleration xyz and gyroscope xyz in each physical hand/chest/ankle IMU. The proposed minimal representation is per-channel mean and population standard deviation over the completed window: twelve summaries per acquired IMU. Exclude heart rate, Optional sessions, orientation, temperature, magnetometer and redundant acceleration range in this primary interface. Do not invent column offsets before the bundled specification is admitted. Stop rather than adapt features after viewing test outcomes.

For this initial complete-group interface, a requested group is unavailable if any chosen raw channel has an invalid timestamp/sample or missing value inside the window. Retain the failed attempt and its quote. No pre-purchase complete missingness mask, unrevealed summary, activity label or subject identifier is an actor input. A static catalog of the three eligible IMU units is public. Only a charged purchase returns the selected unit summaries or its unavailability indicator. Repeated purchase of an already attempted unit is invalid; STOP costs zero.

The primary caps are one and two attempted IMU purchases. Charge one simulator quote even when the requested group is unavailable; define C as the raw attempted-purchase count in quote units, without division by three, consistently with the main tutorial equation and across all caps/policies. Lambda has units of error per quote; changing the cost normalization requires a corresponding lambda rescaling. These are declared proxy units, not measured energy or wall-clock savings. All-three features are an over-budget reference at caps one/two, not a feasible baseline. Include the zero-purchase predictor prior and every fixed subset feasible at each cap.

Train all selectors against the same frozen predictor and the same two policy-fit subjects. For fixed global GREEDY, use the equal-subject attempt-marginal table defined in S26 on a common mask-eligible row set for each S. Failures contribute zero error reduction, remain in the denominator and cost one quote. This global comparator ignores current purchased values and past failure identities when estimating gains; a conditional selector is a different candidate. Account for every offline target-generation read and fitting cost.

Freeze a common candidate/tuning inventory before development selection, including zero-purchase prior, all feasible fixed subsets, the fixed GREEDY rule and the proposed adaptive selector. Bound training passes, seeds, hyperparameter proposals and selector-compute budget. CAFA-ML or BRiG-AFA is a native comparator only under its pinned classifier, unmasker, budget and data protocol; plugging its acquisition rule into this shared-predictor sensor-group interface is an explicitly adapted comparator. Do not merge the native-system and controlled shared-predictor lanes.

For the single-label primary target use alpha=0. The proposed error cap epsilon=0.10 applies to equal-subject mean development error, not worst-subject error or a population guarantee. At each hard cap k, the predeclared feasible set contains candidates with development equal-subject error at most epsilon, no hard-cap violations, and complete failure/cost accounting. Choose minimum equal-subject attempted cost among feasible candidates, then lower development error, then a predeclared simplicity/order key. Do not use reserved-test labels for ties.

If no candidate is feasible, record no_feasible_policy and keep every candidate failure and excess-error distance; do not silently choose the least-infeasible candidate and claim constraint satisfaction. Lambda values 0,1/20,1/5 define separately labeled preference-sensitivity analyses, not a post-hoc way to relax the primary constrained decision. Report equal-subject mean, every subject, worst subject and pooled-window counts; the last two are diagnostics, not covert alternative selection objectives.

Uncertainty must respect subjects rather than treating overlapping or repeated windows as independent subjects. With two proposed test subjects, show the full per-subject table and refrain from broad population or deployment guarantees. Actual eligible groups, archive identity, missingness, fit, policy choice, native baselines and independent transfer remain unobserved.

Erratum for the deliberately preserved earlier scientific record: the Source-mask errors table caption says development, but the displayed 421-cycle quantities are exposed evaluation diagnostics. The historical source bytes remain intact; this current correction prevents using those values as independent policy-selection evidence. In Figure2, component counts printed above bars and normalized right-axis values use different units explicitly explained in the new caption.

The reviewer-input coverage gap was identified separately from manuscript scope. Current benchmark selection and project-specific primary-source records must be frozen into the next review context; their absence from a previous nine-source review bundle did not establish absence from the signed publication run.

Maintain an attempted set T and a successful-observation set S separately. Every attempt increments cost and T; only a valid returned complete group augments S. Query the frozen predictor by S, never by T. At STOP, use the same empty-observation prior, trained on predictor-training subjects with a prespecified class-ID tie rule, if and only if S is empty; otherwise predict from the successfully observed set S, retaining earlier successes after any later failed purchase. Keep their classification errors and consumed cost in every window/subject denominator. No policy may drop unavailable windows after seeing its own acquisition path.

For fixed global GREEDY use S26, not success-conditional mean gain. Maintain successful-observation set S and attempted set T, rank only j outside T, and use the same S-indexed gain table after failures. Positive ties use the declared hand/chest/ankle order. STOP for nonpositive gains or exhausted cap. A reached state with an undefined fit denominator is not_estimable and falls back to STOP with its current valid prediction, never zero gain imputation or row deletion. S26 states the limits of this deliberately history-blind table.

Participant assignment uses predeclared structural admission and a label-independent ID hash, never model outcomes or test class frequencies. Apply the fixed label0/transition curation after assignment and log every resulting window count. The equal-subject formula is defined only if every planned evaluated subject has m_s greater than zero. If any dev/test subject has zero retained windows, record not_evaluable with the original planned subject denominator; do not drop, impute zero error, replace subjects or claim the original reserved test remains untouched. This differs from no_feasible_policy, which requires defined metrics and no candidate meeting the fixed constraints.

supplement.heading: S55. Attempt-marginal global GREEDY with common eligible windows
paragraphs: This section defines a prospective comparator; no PAMAP2 archive was acquired and no selector was fitted. Let S be successfully purchased units and T all attempted units. The actor sees S, T, purchased summaries, remaining cap and a previously fitted table; it receives no current unpurchased availability mask, values or labels. The executor alone resolves a purchase and charges one quote even on failure.

For each planned policy-fit subject s and mask S, I_s(S) contains all prespecified retained policy-fit windows where every group in S is valid. Use this same set for every candidate j outside S; do not additionally restrict it to successful j purchases. A_sij records whether j would return a complete valid group. The after-loss is evaluated only when A=1. Failures retain the prediction f_S, so their error reduction is exactly zero, not an excluded denominator. The empty mask includes every prespecified retained window. Offline target construction may inspect policy-fit labels and availability, with its full collection/compute cost recorded. Define d_sij(S) as the before-minus-after loss on success and exactly zero on failure; the after-loss need not exist for a failed return.

Define m_s(S)=|I_s(S)| and average each subject first, then subjects equally. If any planned subject has m_s(S)=0, the whole S table is not_estimable. Do not drop that subject, replace its mean by zero or change the subject count. At a reached unestimable state, STOP using f_S (the frozen prior only for S empty), keep its error and attempted cost, and separately count this fallback. Do not claim the table was estimated.

This is a global mask-indexed baseline. It does not condition the gain table on current purchased values or the identities of failed earlier attempts. Correlated failures can therefore make it suboptimal. All rows where S is valid are used instead of rows selected by a fitted test policy. There is no causal transport, unbiased on-policy utility or optimality claim. A T-conditioned or observation-conditioned acquisition rule is a separately fitted and budgeted candidate.

Choose the unattempted unit with largest strictly positive g(S,j); break ties by hand/chest/ankle. Attempt it, increase T and cost, augment S only on a valid return, then repeat within the hard cap. Nonpositive best gain, no remaining unit, exhausted cap or an unestimable table causes STOP. The unit-quote rule makes raw-error gain ranking well defined here; non-unit future prices would require a separate declared ranking or constrained optimization, not a silent gain/price ratio.

Constructed counterexample: candidate A fixes nine of100 baseline errors but succeeds on only those nine windows; B succeeds on100 windows and fixes20. Attempt-marginal gains are9/100 versus20/100, favoring B. Success-conditional means are1 versus1/5, incorrectly favoring A for this declared attempt objective. These are invented arithmetic examples, not data frequencies.

Subject weighting can independently reverse a ranking. With one window for subject1 and nine for subject2, A has gains1 and0, whereas B has gains0 and2/9. Equal-subject gains are1/2 versus1/9, but pooled-window gains are1/10 versus1/5. The estimator must follow the predeclared equal-subject target rather than whichever average favors the selected method.

The executed standard-library check enumerates8 complete availability patterns,256 frozen binary per-mask output banks, four caps0..3 and five fixed gain-table patterns:40,960 constructed traces. It checks attempt charging, no repeat purchases, S subset T, failed-return state preservation, tie order, prior-only-when-S-empty and undefined-table STOP. It is a same-author contract check; its trace count is neither independent people nor measured accuracy. analysis/probeflow-v24-results.json and its frozen code document exact denominators and a trace hash.

In the formula, K is the fixed planned policy-fit subject count. For each S, every candidate j uses exactly I_s(S), including j failures; j-specific success filtering is forbidden. Offline target construction is permitted only on the policy-fit subjects under its own charged collection/compute scope. The actor cannot inspect an unpurchased success indicator. After a failed attempt, T grows and S remains unchanged; the same S-indexed table is consulted for the remaining unattempted candidates. A failed after-loss is not evaluated or invented: d is defined as zero by retained f_S, while its quote is still charged.

The40960 count belongs to an already saved same-author synthetic contract check, not a new replay by this edition. Its factors are8availability patterns×256binary frozen per-mask output banks×4caps(0..3)×5gain-table patterns. No PAMAP2 raw acquisition, accuracy result, learned selector, new benchmark or independent participant is supplied by these traces. The current16-policy MHEALTH catalogue is a separate executed study and is not claimed to contain this prospective GREEDY comparator.

algorithm.name: Prospective global mask-indexed attempt-marginal GREEDY
inputs: Frozen predictor f_S (training-only prior for empty S), planned fit subjects, common I_s(S), unit attempted quote, hard attempt cap and fixed hand/chest/ankle tie order.
Offline fitted S-indexed gains, initially S=T=empty; actor observes purchased summaries/failures only, never current unpurchased availability or label.
outputs: STOP plus valid f_S prediction or a sequence of charged attempts; distinct successful S and attempted T; complete failure/cost/fallback denominators.
steps: For every planned fit subject and successful mask S, fix I_s(S) from retained windows where all S groups are valid, using identical rows for every next j.
On successful j define before-minus-after loss; on failed j define d=0 without requesting a nonexistent after-loss, retaining that window and attempted quote.
Average within each subject by m_s(S), then equally over all K planned subjects; if any m_s=0 mark the whole S table not_estimable.
At a reached not_estimable state STOP with current f_S (prior only if S empty), retain prediction error/attempt cost and count this fallback.
Among j outside T, choose strictly positive maximum g(S,j), ties by fixed physical-unit order; STOP when cap exhausted, no candidates or no positive gain.
Attempt j and charge one quote regardless of success; add j to T always, to S and purchased summaries only on a valid complete return.
Continue with the same S-indexed table after failure. No repeated purchase, hidden availability read, subject dropping, zero filling or policy-dependent row filtering is allowed.
Retain all declared evaluation subjects/windows; an empty dev/test subject is not_evaluable, distinct from a defined feasible-set search returning no_feasible_policy.

supplement.heading: Abstract
paragraphs: ProbeFlow examines when additional acquired information improves a frozen predictor and when incomplete observations support only a bounded conclusion. We connect explicit acquisition/disclosure accounting, negative controlled prediction studies, sharp partial identification and exact fixed-subset information design. These are separate estimands, not one pooled benchmark. Conditional proofs establish sharp endpoints, strict full-tie pruning, a shared-marginal heap and static terminal reindexing; they do not establish real acquisition utility.

The most recent saved comparison uses16 policies on524 already exposed development windows from two participants. Action-local support admission corrects16 errors within41 guard-changed windows, with25 error ties and0 local harms. The candidate nevertheless ties local myopic on every paired window, harms39 initially correct windows overall, and has higher macro error-plus-quote loss than strong fixed subset/order controls. No untouched final groups remain. We restore exact preference and support-stratum diagnostics and a prospective failure-inclusive GREEDY denominator contract. This edition performs source synthesis and saved-data arithmetic, with no new fit, inference, acquisition or efficacy experiment.

supplement.heading: 1. Introduction and bounded contributions
paragraphs: Buying a source, computing a statistic and disclosing it to a decision policy are different events. ProbeFlow starts from that accounting problem and asks a stricter question before adding planning: can a frozen predictor use the permitted information better than a strong affordable fixed or myopic rule? The cumulative application record frequently answers no or insufficient_support. Its later identification theory states what follows from declared missing-outcome and availability assumptions; it does not repair a failed application comparison. [C01-C07]

Our contributions are bounded: (i) an explicit public-information and charged-attempt contract with preserved negative comparisons; (ii) sharp original-loss bounds and exact pre-observation subset selection under a specified world model, including every primary and transcript tie; (iii) a proof of static terminal reindexing with a common-deadline counterexample; and (iv) a paired descriptive assessment of action-local support admission against its ablation and stronger matched controls. None claims nonmyopic benefit, physical cost savings, population safety or external-method superiority.

The main paper follows problem, theory, experimental setup and results. Full teaching, assumptions, data admission, EDA, failed executions, proof details and chronological evidence remain in the supplement and55-chapter Korean guide. Every previous body section has one canonical retained location, recorded separately from new synthesis. Edition-specific claims inside historical chapters are dated historical statements; their filenames refer to the frozen source inventory unless the new coverage map supplies a successor.

supplement.heading: 2. Related work and scope of comparison
paragraphs: Joint active feature acquisition/classification [shim2018] motivates set encoding; generative-surrogate acquisition [li2021,gsmrl-local-primary] models sequential actions, STOP and prediction. Our fixed-subset worst-width design instead selects all queries before readings. Matching a name or set notation does not match the objective or policy class. Chronological action masking in the saved time-series source prevents a general transfer of static order invariance.

Adaptive-submodularity guarantees [adaptive-submodularity] require structural assumptions not proved here; a stored complementarity witness violates diminishing returns for this worst-width objective. Repeated selection requires evaluation discipline [cawley2010]. Original AO* body/version identity, including the2002/2004 citation conflict, remains unresolved [inherited-author-index]. No native GSMRL/AO* benchmark was reproduced.

Reference reading is bounded and inherited from the separately saved verifier: official metadata/abstracts and specifically identified GSMRL or Shim opening passages, not full-paper/proof/code reproduction. UCI metadata identify the MHEALTH dataset [uci319], not local physical-axis correctness or clinical validity. The seven reference scope records and exact source hashes remain intact.

supplement.heading: 3. Problem, information rights and objectives
paragraphs: A prediction actor receives only purchased public values, observation mask and allowed support metadata. The executor tracks attempted versus successful acquisition, quotes and failures; the evaluator alone reads gold labels after decisions. Internal source/cache state and public disclosure are distinct. The current same-process implementation is a cooperative interface, not OS isolation. One logical quote is not measured energy, latency or money.

supplement.heading: 4. Method and executable decision contract
paragraphs: At mask1 each feasible optional action has a frozen fitting-leaf mean loss reduction mu and its own support. Admit an action only with at least30 fitting windows from two fitting participants. Select the smallest-index supported action maximizing mu−0.05 if that maximum is strictly positive; otherwise STOP, distinguishing empty support from nonpositive gain. An unsupported alternative does not veto another supported action. The blanket ablation requires every feasible action to be supported before applying the same selection.

The independently implemented local myopic rule sorts these same net values under identical support, STOP and ties, so it defines exactly the same one-step decision map. Fixed subsets buy their single prescribed optional action when supported, without requiring positive fitted net value. Fixed orders additionally apply the specified multiplier to the positive-net test. All16 current arms share predictor, public input, support rights, unit quotes, cap and524 paired windows. They are a limited fixed-prefix catalogue, not a complete full-budget external comparison.

For the robust-design branch, traverse feasible readings of each precommitted subset with exact sharp endpoints and strict certified prefix pruning. Shared-cap DP or the proved marginal heap tightens only the outward envelope; it leaves the sharp oracle and all output ties intact. The integrated algorithm and full proof are retained in the supplement. The prospective mask-indexed GREEDY comparator has its own common eligible-window and failed-attempt contract; it was not executed in the current16-arm study.

supplement.heading: 5. Theory: conditional guarantees and failure boundaries
paragraphs: Action-local admission never buys an unsupported action and uses at most one remaining quote. Its fitted incremental value weakly dominates blanket by cases: when all feasible actions are supported they coincide; otherwise blanket contributes0 while local contributes max(0,best supported net). This is a fitted-value statement. It supplies no realized error or population-safety dominance; the observed39 harms demonstrate the distinction.

For exact design, compatible-world containment gives L(h)<=L(z)<=U(z)<=U(h) for every completed descendant z of prefix h. A completed feasible leaf supplies incumbent b. Prune only when the certified prefix width is strictly below b; equality must be explored to preserve every worst transcript. The shared-cap correction has nonnegative nonincreasing marginal chains; repeatedly taking the largest exposed chain head attains the best at-most-B allocation. It agrees with DP scalar bounds, not a new application result. [C15-C20]

Static terminal theorem: under immutable unique IDs, a common nonempty world set, the same static per-ID observation relation and fixed subset, ID-preserving tuple reindexing is a bijection with identical feasible worlds and endpoints. Immediate always-successful reveals, common terminal STOP, additive price and no chronology restrictions extend this to cost and terminal prediction. Literal action traces, prefix diagnostics, cache/incumbent behavior and work are not preserved. A two-item common-deadline construction violates the static assumptions and yields0/4 versus4/4 completions, not an algorithm benchmark. [C23-C28]

The solver remains exponential: all subset/binary-reading pairs total3^N. Heap bounds concern its local allocator, with rational bits and output length separate. Stop-only work, shared child objects versus serialized policy length, full deployment and physical acquisition costs remain unresolved. The non-submodular witness and stronger exact controls prevent a generic greedy or total-cost superiority claim.

supplement.heading: 10. Limitations and conclusion
paragraphs: The evidence comprises exposed local prediction cohorts, declared mathematical world models and finite constructed witnesses. It supplies neither an untouched confirmatory population nor measured physical acquisition utility. Support thresholds are admission counts, not calibrated guarantees. Preference and root-range analyses are post-hoc diagnostics. New source coverage, check counts, page counts and theorem exactness do not turn them into practical improvement.

ProbeFlow currently contributes explicit information/attempt accounting, preserved negative comparisons, sharp assumption-dependent identification and exact fixed-subset design with full ties. Action-local admission improves one blanket-guard contrast locally, while matched myopic ties and stronger fixed-policy regressions remain decisive. A next application claim requires independently frozen groups, prespecified utility, real failure/delay/cost receipts and the strongest feasible controls under common data, public information, tuning and acquisition budgets. Scientific status remains needs_evidence; scientific certification, gate closure, promotion and submission are false.

paragraphs: The question is whether incomplete-log identification sets preserve contextual acquisition gains against strong fixed strategies, and whether risk correction changes the error/cost/harm of a frozen predictor on already exposed development participants. supplement.heading: Conditional guarantee and its limits
paragraphs: For Delta_j(h)=E[L_b-L_j|h], the good simultaneous-containment event gives J_gate<=J_b and J_gate-min_j J_j<=B-A. A is the contextual oracle gap over the complete frozen menu; B averages the true best contrast width on supported contexts and M on unsupported ones. Let D=E_H[max_j Delta_j-Delta_gate]. Bounded terminal losses imply0<=D<=M=23/20 on all events and D<=B on the good event. Thus expected baseline regret is at most delta*M and expected menu regret is at most E[B-A]+delta*M under the stated sampling assumptions. These elementary bounds do not establish novelty, arbitrary-MNAR/OOD safety or DEV calibration.

paragraphs: Main and oracle stages run once. Oracle reconstructs1024 controlled terminal affines and all512 interval slots, literal gates, coupled global values and A/B/D separately. For DEV it checks3598 equivalence records, split, tau selection,38 states per estimator, all60 decision tables, C references,31440 final paths and per-person/macro/paired arithmetic. It does not reopen DEV, infer the forest again or import author experiment functions.

Main controlled has10 planned/completed case records, including diagnostic empty/outside states; DEV has31440 planned/started/completed, failed0,unknown0,unstarted0. Failed query mass in controlled is an observed paid outcome rather than an execution failure. Preparation incidents and comparator/diagnostic failures are retained separately. Scientific interpretation remains needs_evidence despite exit0.

supplement.heading: Costs, bytes, computational scope and omissions
paragraphs: COST_ACCOUNTING reconciles each measured arm total with disjoint named phases plus residual. DEV paths/recording are one combined measured phase, not isolated provider/selection/serialization clocks. The same common preparation/prediction cache is charged identically in an accounting scenario to all policies; actual work is not multiplied by60. No policy-specific runtime speedup is claimed.

General vertex enumeration and root-combination complexity are exponential in variable dimension/context count; exact rational bit size and output storage matter. DEV uses a finite token state table but state growth is exponential in blocks. Original input bytes, explicit repeated reads, raw output bytes and conservative4MiB interactive-read allowance are distinguished. Installed-module traffic, physical reads/energy, peak/transient memory, historical fit and final launcher/reporting tails stay null.

The CPU/wall limits are cooperative, not OS security isolation or hard deadlines. No new dependency, account, model, API, download, worker, scheduler, service or global/active skill change occurred. Authoring model usage is unmetered and cannot be inferred from experiment model_api_calls0.

supplement.heading: Related work and release boundary
paragraphs: The required diagnosis, data-admission and inherited primary-read records are copied and hashed. Their metadata and attributed proposal notes are not freshly verified primary passages or reproduced external methods. Existing robust baseline regret/fallback overlap and an unresolved closest-overlap lead remain open; no novelty or conference-readiness claim follows.

Only existing build_documents.validate is called for literal manuscript schema; no rendering, PDF, METHOD, VERIFICATION, INTAKE, AOP, publication, Git push or global skill activation is performed. Coordinator owns independent review and subsequent intake. Parent results and all old research runs remain unchanged.

supplement.heading: 문제와 이번 기여
paragraphs: W49의 static-sufficient +1/40은 정적 failure-abstain 정책 누락 때문에 적응 이익으로 해석할 수 없었다. W50은 고정된 acquisition 순서에도 관측별 STOP·abstain 권리를 모두 주고, 문맥 적응과 추정기 변경을 교차 대조하도록 사전 계약을 고정했다.
이번 기여는 순서 제약과 종료 규칙을 분리한 완전 정책 문법 및 정확한 분해 최적화다. 새 controlled 계산은 완료했으나 DEV 연결과 원시 검산이 실패했다. 과학 상태는 failed이며 실제 응용의 추정기 효과 분리는 미완료다.

supplement.heading: 알고리즘·정보와 정당성
paragraphs: 고정 순서는 H와 무관하게 공유된다. 그 순서 안의 STOP·abstain은 H와 모든 획득 이력에 의존할 수 있다. 따라서 같은 공개 정보와 실패 권리를 주면서 acquisition 순서의 적응성만 제한한다. 다음 query의 성공 여부나 숨은 값을 먼저 보는 정책은 허용하지 않는다.

같은 첫 순서에서 마지막 STOP/A 선택2개, 그 전 이력에서는 STOP/A 또는 두 번째 query의8개 종료 지도로10개 선택이 있다. 첫 query의 세 관측 가지를 합치면1002나무다. 두 H의 같은 순서 정책 공간은 중복4개를 빼2008004개이며, H별 첫 순서도 다른 전체 공간은4008004개다. 역방향 최소화는 이 문법의 모든 결정적 정책을 포함한다. 혼합 정책은 동일 선형 목적함수에서 더 작은 값을 만들지 않는다.

supplement.heading: 직접 관측: static 동률, contextual 비용 차이
paragraphs: 두 추정기 모두 static-sufficient에서 reference와 적응 정책의 나무가 완전히 같고 J=33/160, 이득0이다. 누락된 실패 보류를 채운 정적 대조가 이전 가짜 적응 이득을 제거하는 방향과 일치한다. 다른 모형의 새 결과이며 W49 숫자를 소급 정정하지 않는다.
contextual에서는 reference J=35/160, 적응과 근시안 모두33/160으로 차이1/80이다. 초기 quote를 포함한 평균 quote가5/2에서9/4로 줄고 coverage7/8은 같다. 점 추정기 변경으로 선택과 J가 바뀌지 않아 controlled estimator effect=0이며 유한지평이 근시안보다 낫다는 근거도 없다.
통제의 사람별 결과 대신 두 선언 문맥별 오류·J·quote·coverage 및 짝지은 교정/피해를 기록했다. 같은 참가자로 해석하지 않는다. 완전 terminal 지표의 oracle는 부동소수점 오류율 표현에서 멈췄으므로 전체 검산 통과로 쓰지 않는다.

supplement.heading: 실패와 미실행이 결론에 미치는 영향
paragraphs: 본실험은 DEV 선택 metadata에서 mask15의 예측을 찾다 KeyError로 끝났다. 네 센서가 모두 있는 mask15는 추가 구매2회 계약 밖이며 저장 일곱 mask 예측에도 없다. 선택표 동결·DEV bank 읽기·사람별 비교·경로12576개는 수행되지 않았다.
별도 raw-only oracle는16032개 열거 점수와 최소값/reference/certificate 대조 prefix를 지난 뒤 exact7/160과 binary-float 저장값의 불일치로 실패했다. 두 오류 모두 unit smoke가 다루지 못한 실제 경계다. 미래 수정안을 이 봉인 실행의 성공으로 계산하지 않는다.

supplement.heading: 조건부 인증, 복잡도와 주장 한계
paragraphs: 새 인증은 두 token별 Bernoulli calibration 표본의 Hoeffding 구간을 함께 만족하는 직사각형을 쓴다. 참값이 안에 있고 알려진 공통 세계가 맞으면 모든 전체 정책의 affine 대조가 동시에 포함된다. reference와 정책이 C에 의존해도 이 uniform 포함 아래 하한 gate의 reference 대비 비악화가 따른다. 한 seed의 참값 포함은 population coverage 실측이 아니다.
일반 고정 순서 B단계의 syntactic 나무 수는 T0=2, T_b=2+(T_{b-1})^r로 빠르게 증가한다. explicit 공통 세계 N개와 충분 상태 S개가 주어질 때 DP는 각 상태·행동·세계의 유리수 계산과 저장을 요구한다. S 자체가 관측 수/차원에 지수적으로 늘 수 있고 bit 길이와 실제 파일 byte를 별도 비용으로 센다.
본실험 exit1·oracle exit1을 보존하며 science_status=failed다. 완결된 실패 보고는 태스크의 완료와 구별한다. 봉인 후 코드·계약·입력을 수정하거나 재실행하지 않았다.
통제 모형은 W49의 네 좌표 혼합로그 공동-polytope와 다르다. H 사이에 공유되는 두 label 확률, 알려진8세계와 직접 iid Bernoulli label 표본을 가정한다. 이 단순화는 정적 종료 권리라는 이번 질문을 분리하기 위한 것이며 W49의 보장·신규성·응용 결과를 상속하지 않는다.
모든 MHEALTH1..10은 과거 사용됐다. 계획 DEV는 노출7/8의2명·524고유창이며 이번 평가 완료는0명/0창, 독립 final-test는0명이다. 정책경로·합성세계·검사 수를 사람 또는 독립 표본 수로 세지 않는다.
신규 외부 원문 읽기0이며 closest prior-art overlap, 정확한 판본/가정/재현과 신규성은 미해결이다. 상속 metadata나 독립 검토자의 동의를 사실/과학 인증으로 바꾸지 않는다.
quote는 논리 비용이다. 센서 I/O·전력·물리 속도·provider 실패율·population coverage·MNAR/OOD 안전은 검증하지 않았다. 실험 model_api_calls=0/native_episodes=0과 SOL 저술 사용량 미계측을 구별한다.

supplement.heading: 사전 계약·출처·단회 위상
paragraphs: TASK 해시379543ef3048eb0bc49742f4eba7ff28265b636294f8d9130d4d37b360062fb9와 사전 evaluation_contract를 고정했다. TASK parents5개, latest METHOD2개, task builder 및 source pins를 시작 시 실제 bytes로 비교했다. WAVE의 parent RESULT 경로/hash와 정확히 같은 parent를 유지한다.

prepare→smoke4→unit10→seal→main1→oracle1을 실행했다. prepare/smoke/unit/seal exit0, main/oracle exit1이다. 실패한 stage는 다시 실행하지 않았다. commands의 START/command/exit/log hash가 실제 실행 근거이며 shell 대화나 저술을 별도 과학 episode로 만들지 않는다.
초기 schema 확인에서 부모의 DEV 첫1행을 이미 보았다. 이 자료는 원래부터 공개된 DEV이며 새로운 독립 holdout이라고 부르지 않는다. 본 main에서는 선택 실패로 DEV bank를 열지 않았다. 이 구분은 EXPERIMENT_INCIDENTS와4MiB 사전읽기 예약에 남긴다.

supplement.heading: 정적 정책 완전성의 유도
paragraphs: 적격 정책은 H를 받은 뒤 STOP/A 또는 지정 순서의 첫 query를 택한다. query가 반환한0/1/F마다 STOP/A 또는 순서의 다음 query를 택하고, 마지막 query의 세 결과마다 STOP/A를 택한다. 실패도 quote/시도를 소비하고 같은 action을 반복하지 않는다. 성공 뒤 abstain과 두 번째 실패 뒤 abstain도 빠지지 않는다.

순서[1]은[1,2]에서 첫 query 뒤 모두 terminal인 나무로, 빈 순서는 두 maximal-order 문법의 root terminal로 포함된다. first1/first2의 유일한 공통 나무는 root STOP/A다. 따라서 한 H의 union은1002+1002-2=2002이고 두 H에서 같은 first를 쓰는 union은2*1002²-2²이다.
일반 나무의 첫 결정과 각 관측 아래 자식은 선형 기대손실 합으로 연결된다. 고정된 부모 결정에서 자식 최소화가 전체 최소화와 교환되므로 Bellman 역귀납으로 전수 정책 최소와 같다. 이것은 선언 문법/공통 세계에서의 수학적 정당성이지 실측 성능이나 외부 방법의 신규성 증명이 아니다.

supplement.heading: 새 controlled 확률 실험과 비교 조건
paragraphs: H 두 값은 각각1/2이고 A/B/F는8개 균등 세계다. q1은 F=1,B=0일 때, q2는 F=1,A=0일 때 실패한다. 실패는 F만 반환하고 추가 quote1을 청구한다. predictor는 필요한 token을 획득했으면 그 token, 없으면0이다. STOP은 predictor를 반환하고 A는 null과 고정 손실2/5를 반환한다.
theta는 두 token값에 대한(1/20,19/20)이며 H 사이에 공유된다. train64/token seed50051, calibration4096/token seed50052의 고정 PRNG를 써8320개 고유 합성 label을 생성했다. H마다 로그를 복제해 표본 수를 늘리지 않는다. 독립 iid Bernoulli 모형/알려진 세계는 가정이다.

empirical=eT/nT, calibrated=(eC+64*empirical)/(nC+64)이며 C가 없으면 prior를 쓴다. 두 비교군 모두 같은 T/C 정보에 접근하고 추가 tuning은0이다. 같은 추정기 안에서는 reference/adaptive/myopic/gate가 predictor·세계·실패·abstain·support·quote·남은 budget을 공유한다. estimator 이름이 다르면 데이터 사용량이 다르다는 의도한 조작만 달라진다.

supplement.heading: 인증 계산과 실패 경계
paragraphs: nC=4096, delta1/20일 때 radius=ceil(1e6*sqrt(log(4/delta)/(2*nC)))/1e6이다. 두 Bernoulli 평균 구간을[0,1]과 교차하고 네 꼭짓점을 쓴다. 모든 정책의 error+quote는 theta에 affine이므로 최소/최대는 꼭짓점에 있다. 대조 두 정책은 같은 world와 같은 theta를 사용한다.
공동 포함 사건의 확률 하한은 두 좌표 Hoeffding과 union bound에 의존한다. data-dependent 정책까지 동시에 affine 포함을 적용하기 때문에 C와 선택 간 별도 독립성으로 가장하지 않는다. 미지원 C 진단4개는 reference를 유지한다. 이 단순 직사각형 모형은 W49의 비직사각4차원 혼합집합과 같지 않다.

outside_flipped와 outside_zero는 이번 계약에는 사전 명시한 진단이다. 네 경우 모두 참값이 집합 밖이나 reference 대비 gate regret는 static0/contextual-1/80으로 피해 반례를 만들지 못했다. 임의 OOD 안전으로 일반화할 수 없고, 과거 W49 사후 theta0 대입도 이번 사전 결과로 고쳐 쓰지 않는다.

supplement.heading: 기록된 문맥별 오류·비용·보류와 피해
paragraphs: ordinary의 adaptive/myopic/reference 관련 예측 가능 mass는7/8이며 오류 mass는 기록상0.04375다. 정확한 수학값7/160과 serialized binary-float 차이 때문에 oracle가 멈췄다. 값이 작아 보인다는 이유로 tolerance를 사후 추가하거나 raw를 고치지 않았다. J와 quote 항은 유리수 문자열이다.

static-sufficient 양 H와 contextual 적응 정책의 J=33/160, quote9/4, failure3/8, abstain1/8이다. contextual 고정 reference는 H0 quote9/4/J33/160, H1 quote11/4/J37/160으로 macro35/160이다. 같은 terminal 예측끼리의 correction/harm mass는 ordinary reference 대조에서0/0이며 비용 차이가 핵심이다. 이 숫자는 raw 단회 관측이고 전체 metric 검산은 미완료다.
더 강한 정적 비교군을 준 뒤 작은 contextual 이득만 남았고 empirical/calibrated 선택은 같았다. 따라서 이 controlled 자료에서는 추정 보정 효과0과 H별 action 비용 차이를 개념적으로 구별할 수 있으나 현실 DEV에서 두 요인을 분리했다는 결론은 실패 때문에 내릴 수 없다.

supplement.heading: DEV 설계와 실제 선택 단계 오류
paragraphs: 설계는 subject5/6의 T168+154=322,C96+96=192를 쓰고38상태를 만든다. support는 T30이상·양쪽 참가자 및 모든 양의 확률 successor의 같은 조건이다. 일곱 mask1/3/5/9/7/11/13만 허용하며 initial1와 추가 두 block까지만 산다.
각10고정 순서의 전체 STOP/A/next 결정 최적값을 계산하고, adaptive와myopic을 더해 추정기당12정책을 만들 계획이었다. calibrated tau64는 상속 설계에서 고정한 값이며 새 CV/tuning은0이다. 참된 state posterior와 다른 surrogate 위험/전이를 최적화한다는 한계를 유지한다.

실제 dev_select는 states metadata의 branches를 만들면서3block 마지막 상태에도 나머지 block의 자식 info를 요구했다. child mask15의 cached predictions가 없어 KeyError가 발생했다. actions 예산 검사는 먼저 실행됐어도 metadata 생성 경로는 제한하지 못했다. 이는 단일 shared domain 경계에서 고칠 문제이나 여기서는 봉인을 지켰다.
DEV selection 자체는시작1/실패1이고 정책표 생성완료0/24, 경로시작0/12576이다. 평가 예정2명/524창을 실제 평가 결과로 보고하지 않는다. 오류·J·quote·coverage·paired 교정/피해·estimator interaction은 전부 null/미실행이다.

algorithm.name: 노출 DEV의 추정기 교차 대조와 실패 반환
inputs: 해시로 연결한 기존 training514행, 평가 예정 DEV524행

T의 참가자별 초기 상태 비율로 reference를 선정하고 적응·근시안 표와 함께 저장·해시 동결한다.

supplement.heading: 검산 prefix와 검증 공백
paragraphs: oracle는 research.py나 부모 코드를 import하지 않았다. 나무 번호를 radix10/bit leaf 방식으로 복호화하고 직접 잠재 세계를 따라가16032개 점수를 재계산했다. 저장 minima와 reference/게이트 꼭짓점 대조도 이 prefix 안에서 비교한 뒤 첫 지표의 exact equality에 실패했다.

REPORT의 checks16146은 시도 수이며 마지막 하나가 실패하므로 그 전 통과는16145다. 각 arm은 한 번씩만 시도했다. DEV oracle는 선택표가 없어서 FileNotFoundError로 실패했다. 두 구현을 같은 작성자가 썼고 독립 과학 검토는 coordinator의 후속 범위다. 완전 verifier 통과·과학 인증·publication readiness를 주장하지 않는다.
smoke4와unit10은 fixture이며 DEV 전체 metadata 경계 및 aggregate type 보존을 잠그지 못했다. 테스트 통과를 본실험 성공으로 치환하지 않는다. 새 regression은 다음 Task에서 실제 seven-mask/terminal branch 및 exact type aggregate를 다뤄야 한다.

supplement.heading: 일반 복잡도·실제 byte·자원 계측
paragraphs: r개 결과와 B번 구매인 고정 순서의 전체 syntax 수는 T0=2,T_b=2+T_{b-1}^r다. 전체 policy 나무를 나열하면 이 크기만큼 시간/출력이 든다. 충분 상태를 쓰면 각 state에서 terminal2와 허용 query의 조건부 기대를 비교하므로 대략 O(S*d*r*N) 유리수 연산으로 평가/최적화할 수 있으나 N개 compatible world 집계를 상태마다 반복하는 구현 비용이 남는다.

d개 센서의 acquired/failure/value 상태 자체가 대략(r+1)^d로 증가할 수 있다. H별 tree 선택은 지수적인 joint catalogue를 분해하는 것이고 공통 순서 선택은 order별 H 최소를 합산한다. exact rational은 분모/분자의 bit 길이에 의존하며 단위 시간 실수 연산으로 세지 않는다. arbitrary histories가 상태로 압축되지 않으면 더 많은 history 상태가 필요하다.
DEV의 단순 위험표 계산은 O(S*(nT+nC)*d), K고정 순서의 DP와 표 저장은 대략 O(K*S*d*r), raw 경로는 O(nEval*K*B)시간/출력을 요구한다. 이번에는 metadata 실패로 뒤 비용을 지출하지 않았다. 수학적 bound와 실제 측정1회 비용을 구분한다.

COST_ACCOUNTING.json은 준비/main/oracle 직접 process CPU와 launcher wall, 명시 읽기 및 실제 output byte를 기록한다. unit의 직접 CPU는null이다. source hashes는 시작/checkpoint/종료의 POLICY·reviewer·builder가 동일함을 확인한다. 실제 OS IO·peak memory·SOL 저술·Orca 전송 tail은null/미계측이다.

supplement.heading: 관련연구·승격·다음 단계
paragraphs: 본실험 exit1·oracle exit1을 보존하며 science_status=failed다. 완결된 실패 보고는 태스크의 완료와 구별한다. 봉인 후 코드·계약·입력을 수정하거나 재실행하지 않았다.
통제 모형은 W49의 네 좌표 혼합로그 공동-polytope와 다르다. H 사이에 공유되는 두 label 확률, 알려진8세계와 직접 iid Bernoulli label 표본을 가정한다. 이 단순화는 정적 종료 권리라는 이번 질문을 분리하기 위한 것이며 W49의 보장·신규성·응용 결과를 상속하지 않는다.
모든 MHEALTH1..10은 과거 사용됐다. 계획 DEV는 노출7/8의2명·524고유창이며 이번 평가 완료는0명/0창, 독립 final-test는0명이다. 정책경로·합성세계·검사 수를 사람 또는 독립 표본 수로 세지 않는다.
신규 외부 원문 읽기0이며 closest prior-art overlap, 정확한 판본/가정/재현과 신규성은 미해결이다. 상속 metadata나 독립 검토자의 동의를 사실/과학 인증으로 바꾸지 않는다.
quote는 논리 비용이다. 센서 I/O·전력·물리 속도·provider 실패율·population coverage·MNAR/OOD 안전은 검증하지 않았다. 실험 model_api_calls=0/native_episodes=0과 SOL 저술 사용량 미계측을 구별한다.
동일 process의 함수 인자 제한은 협력적 정보 경계이며 OS 격리가 아니다. 위험표와 전이표는 일관된 joint label posterior가 아닐 수 있다. 지수 정책 공간의 동적계획법 목적함수 최적성을 현실의 최적성으로 바꾸지 않는다.
준비·본실험·oracle의 저장 process CPU/wall 및 launcher wall을 구별한다. 단위검사의 직접 CPU, OS/stdlib 읽기, peak memory, 과거 모델 학습, shell/Orca 최종 전송 및 SOL token 비용은 미계측이다. 수동 사전 읽기는4MiB 예약량이며 정확 계측이 아니다.
사전 outside-flipped/zero 진단4건은 모두 gate의 reference 대비 양의 피해를 보이지 않았다. 같은 세계에서 종료 예측이 같고 quote만 줄어드는 이번 구조에서는 분포 이탈만으로 피해 반례가 생기지 않을 수 있다. 이 진단 실패를 W49 사후 theta0 분석의 성공으로 대체하지 않는다.
원고 schema는 기존 build_documents.validate로만 확인한다. METHOD_REVIEW/VERIFICATION/INTAKE/AOP/조판/게시는 작성하지 않는다. SKILL_CANDIDATE는 비활성 실패 사례 메모이고 전역 스킬·운영 상태·공유 모델 서버는 변경하지 않는다.

supplement.heading: Finite-law identity and proof scope
paragraphs: For any fixed eligible tree and any positive-mass observed state, conditional expected terminal loss plus future quote cost under P equals its frozen-tree recurrence. At leaves this is the definition of conditional error/abstain. At a query, partition the same row set by observed token, apply the induction hypothesis to each child and the law of total expectation. Add exactly one query charge. The finite horizon proves the identity.

Adaptive/fixed Bellman tables use this whole continuation. A myopic one-step value is checked against a directly truncated continuation, and its frozen replanning tree is scored separately. This identity establishes coherence only under the declared empirical P; it gives no population risk, safety or new-algorithm theorem.

supplement.heading: Exploratory results and fair controls
paragraphs: Each estimator supplies12 policies at each of three total budgets; all108 policy tables and56592 paths reuse524 unique windows from only two previously exposed people. Per-person corrections and harms compare only pairs where both predict; abstain transitions, coverage and cost are separate.

Budget changes re-optimize policies at the same fixed lambda, rather than re-score one policy. Estimator changes are compared within a policy family; adaptive gains are compared with same-estimator static and myopic controls. DEV-best fixed order remains descriptive hindsight.

supplement.heading: Computational scope, prior work and limitations
paragraphs: All MHEALTH1..10 were previously exposed. DEV is two already-exposed people7/8 and524 unique windows; independent final-test people0. Window/policy multiplicity is not independent sample size; no IID window CI.
The forest/prediction bank is inherited frozen data. This is coherent estimation and matched decision diagnosis, not joint predictor training, new model inference or population calibration.

Coherent_joint changes participant balancing, the unconditional risk/kernel law and transition weighting together. Its difference from legacy_statewise is a bundled estimator change, not an identified causal effect of coherence alone. Fixed acquisition orders retain adaptive history-dependent stopping; they are not completely nonadaptive masks.

No external primary-source reads or closest-method reproduction were performed here. Finite Bellman planning, risk calibration and reference fallback alone establish no algorithmic novelty or SOTA. Parent literature audit and independent method review remain separate.

Logical quote cost1/20 is not measured sensor latency, energy, physical I/O or provider failure. Cached rows have no failure outcomes; missingness, MNAR, OOD and safe-policy guarantees are unmeasured.

No-eviction persistent DAG caching alone has order-independent cost for a fixed acquired set: pay the union of required ancestors once. Adaptive set/STOP changes can change this union; a static policy has the same cache rights. This is an algebraic observation, not a cache experiment.

Common T support checks the union of positive T and joint successors, so calibrated C-only mass cannot buy privileged acquisitions. Unsupported current states force STOP; supported fixed policies with blocked next query retain STOP/abstain. This explicit fair-domain correction is shared across every estimator.

Direct process CPU/wall and explicit bytes are measured. Authoring/model token charges, preledger exact reads, historical fit, peak memory, OS/stdlib reads, physical I/O and final shell tail remain unmeasured. Manual preledger reads reserve4MiB; quotas are cooperative, not OS isolation.

supplement.heading: Problem and output contract
paragraphs: Precommit affordable fixed subset S before reading: minimize worst feasible closed-bin sharp macro route-minus-static interval width R(S)=max_z[U(S,z)-L(S,z)], under the unchanged original r/v independent box/mean and globally capped binary requested-error model. Exact output is one lex(R,cost,mask) winner, not all primary/transcript ties. Epsilon 1/32 is an absolute macro-loss-width tolerance and certifies scalar regret only.

Same robust sharp-width objective was solved under a one-winner contract. Exact objective improvement is 0/no_gain by design. supplement.heading: F. Previous completed main paper: exact historical copy
paragraphs: The following fourteen structured sections preserve the complete earlier main narrative before reordering and copyediting. Their local section, algorithm, table and figure references identify the earlier edition. Current interpretation is in the new main paper; these dated source copies are retained to prevent silent scientific omissions.

supplement.heading: Abstract
paragraphs: Information design and sequential prediction have different objectives and different opportunities for improvement. ProbeFlow develops a certified single-winner search for the fixed-subset problem of minimizing the worst sharp conditional loss-interval width under a hard query budget. Verified feasible readings supply lower bounds for the outer subset minimization, while partial-transcript widths supply upper bounds for the inner maximization. Exact lexicographic selection and an absolute epsilon certificate replace the earlier all-tie output contract.

Seven constructed conditions, four solvers and three cold cyclic orders yield 84 completed runs. In the hardest eight-coordinate condition, all exact solvers return risk 21/64 and the same unique design; observed median CPU is 0.71875 s for a strong memoized value-only DP and 0.28125 s for exact branch-and-bound, with maximum traced Python peaks 334,535 and 141,338 bytes. Joint CPU/peak wins occur in only 2/7 conditions. A separate participant-balanced acquisition estimator on 524 previously exposed windows is coherent but regresses, ties its fixed/myopic controls and has no independent final participants. We therefore claim bounded engineering gains and conditional certificates, with no accuracy improvement, universal speedup or population-safety claim.

supplement.heading: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: A system may improve the computation of an information design without improving the accuracy of a prediction policy. These are different claims. ProbeFlow studies both questions under explicit information and cost contracts: a fixed subset of queries can reduce uncertainty about a loss contrast, while a sequential policy can buy features to reduce classification-plus-acquisition loss. Sharing an acquisition vocabulary does not make their objectives or evidence interchangeable.

Our main algorithmic result concerns the former problem. We retain the original sharp endpoint model and hard query budget, but change the output from every primary-risk subset and every worst reading to one canonical subset and one witness. This permits equality pruning inside a numeric maximum. More importantly, a finite bank of verified worlds yields a lower bound for every subset represented by an outer search node. A best-bound frontier combines that lower bound with an exact feasible incumbent and returns either the exact risk/cost/mask winner or an absolute epsilon gap.

We test this search against both the original all-tie solver and a strong value-only dynamic program that merges repeated subset orders and receives the same inner solver, cache rights, greedy warm start and global floor. The result is conditional: exact branch-and-bound reduces CPU and traced peak together in two of seven conditions; DP wins or ties elsewhere. The objective itself does not improve because every exact method solves the same problem. The separate application study supplies a useful counterpoint: internally coherent risk/kernel estimation does not imply better decisions.

The contributions are a single-winner/epsilon contract, code-matched bound proofs, a matched strong-DP comparison with retained negative cases, and a separate negative acquisition diagnostic. The supplement and Korean guide retain all legacy results, endpoint derivations, failures and source-inspection limits.

figure.caption: Information and cost architecture. O denotes observed source material, C internal computations and X actor-visible purchased information. Offline fitting/evaluation rights differ from paid policy inputs; caches confer no right to inspect an unpurchased value. The fixed-subset search operates on a declared public world model, while the application actor receives purchased tokens only. These are cooperative interfaces, not OS isolation.

supplement.heading: 2. Related work and comparable rights
paragraphs: Active feature acquisition chooses observations and terminal predictions [1, 2]. The closest selected primary source already contains fixed predictors, terminal risks, conditional acquisition kernels, hard budgets and Bellman comparison [8]. Our participant-balanced row construction is not a new Bellman principle or joint predictor training. Learning-To-Measure pretrains then freezes a predictor and learns conditional/meta-policy structure [9]; SEFA uses latent gradient/Monte Carlo acquisition and grants a test availability mask in its selected availability experiment [10]. AFAPE concerns counterfactual acquisition-plus-misclassification cost under identification and positivity assumptions [11]. Local count support is not whole-policy identification.

The fixed-subset worst-width objective instead commits to queries before reading their closed bins. The retained complementarity witness violates diminishing returns, so a greedy warm start has no transferred adaptive-submodularity guarantee [7]. Branch-and-bound, lower bounds and exact subset DP are established general ideas; this study evaluates the specified variant and certificates, not external novelty, AO* correspondence or an external implementation benchmark. Repeated exposed-DEV selection remains a separate concern [3].

Table 1 summarizes selected-source rights rather than published numerical performance. Its audit read selected HTML sections and official metadata, with inherited capture/prefix limits retained separately. Full-paper proofs and code were not reproduced. A representation invariant to item order does not make deadlines, failures or stateful cache behavior order invariant.

tables.caption: Selected primary-source comparison: information, terminal and computation rights. These sources were not reproduced as numerical baselines.

supplement.heading: 3. Two problems and one information ledger
paragraphs: Fixed-subset design. A nonempty compatible-world set Omega defines an original route-minus-static macro loss contrast Delta. Query i has positive integer price c_i and a guaranteed closed-bin observation relation. Choose subset S before any readings. A feasible transcript z restricts the original worlds to Omega(S,z), with sharp endpoints L(S,z) and U(S,z). Empty intersections are impossible readings, never zero endpoints. Closed bins overlap at their threshold, so a boundary world can support both labels.

The exact representative minimizes the tuple (R(S),c(S),mask(S)) subject to c(S)<=Q. Risk is the maximum conditional interval width over feasible complete readings. The original all-tie contract additionally returned every affordable primary-risk mask and every worst transcript. The new contract returns one canonical representative and one worst witness per completed risk. An epsilon guarantee concerns absolute macro-loss interval-width units, not accuracy percentages or relative prediction regret.

Sequential prediction. A public state contains paid values/tokens, successful groups S_a, all attempted groups T_a, remaining cap and permitted cache/history metadata. STOP uses the current frozen predictor; ABSTAIN incurs a specified loss. Every attempt is charged, including failures in contracts that contain failure. Current cached DEV has successful returns only, so its attempt and success sets coincide; physical provider reliability is unmeasured. Gold labels and full feature caches are evaluator-only inputs.

Participant means precede equal-person averaging. E counts errors on predictions, A abstentions and C attempted quotes; every planned n_s must be positive.
